summary: Restored Q16 workspace vocabulary across quick and child creation, type labels/filters/groups, recurrence templates and agent summaries while retaining internal work/k-work and the existing components. Restored Type: Ticket spec coverage; added default/custom naming, identity, failure and draft-isolation regressions. 32 targeted web unit tests, app typecheck, touched-source lint, CI shard check and 89-case browser collection pass; 10 naming regressions fail on b705fb87 for the expected labels. Remote browser execution/screenshots remain unavailable because OPS-247 keeps the launcher disabled; the Go-only remote-test.sh requires a prohibited Git push and no Go package changed. No push, deploy, migration, secret access, model review or other worktree access. Needs Opus design for further layout work; this scoped naming fix reuses existing UI.

review_finding.result: Fixed product labels and restored Type: Ticket. Default/custom names now come from the workspace vocabulary instead of hard-coded Work item.

decisions.internal_kind: Keep work and k-work; no API or migration changes.
decisions.default_names: Keep existing workLevel defaults Ticket/Epic/Story and existing legacy kind names Ticket/Epic/Task. Names returned by the server take precedence for existing rows.
decisions.generic_copy: Retain approved creation/nesting doctrine in vocabulary settings and operational headings such as Work queue and Work actions; these describe features rather than type names.
decisions.ui: Reuse existing PAIMOS components, chip layout, clip-tip directive and stability guard; only constrain long type labels to fit. Needs Opus design for additional layout work.

safety.identity: Vocabulary reads reset and abort on tenant/person changes; generations reject late answers. Creation re-checks the captured project/person/tenant and nested parent revision after a naming read. The route guard re-checks the signed-in session after its added vocabulary read; read failures show an error.
safety.drafts: Accepted vocabulary is copied away from editable settings drafts; failed saves never publish new names.
safety.bounds: Naming reads have a 10-second total abort bound; server vocabulary names and levels retain their existing limits.
